en: Colorized historic view of a town square with cobblestone paving and surrounding multi‑story buildings in late 19th/early 20th‑century European style. In the center is a fountain with a statue on a pedestal. Horse‑drawn carts and a few pedestrians move across the market square. Hills with additional buildings rise behind the town. The caption at the top reads "Sebnitz, Sächs. Schweiz, Markt," indicating the market square in Sebnitz in the Saxon Switzerland region.
